AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Commando trainee
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained for commando strikes as a member of a small unit. [PAWN_pronoun] has been through extensive combat and survival training.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained for commando strikes as a marksman in a small unit. [PAWN_pronoun] has been through extensive combat and survival training, specializing in marksmanship.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Combat medic trainee

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Infantry trainee
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained for infantry deployment as part of a large unit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Marine trainee
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained for amphibious operations - recieving general infantry combat training, as well as special training for diving and aquatic operations.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Comms specialist trainee

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Infantry medic trainee

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Infantry frontliner trainee
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained for front-line infantry deployment as part of the melee vanguard of a large unit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army commander
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] leads troops as their commander. [PAWN_pronoun] has successfully led troops through a number of conflicts.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc commander
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] leads a troop of mercenaries as their commander. [PAWN_pronoun] has successfully led troops through a number of conflicts.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to one of the larger units, serving through several major conflicts.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was contracted with a large mercenary unit, serving through several major conflicts.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army gunsmith
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s training was augmented with gunsmithing and maintenance, serving [PAWN_possessive] platoon's needs for weapon maintenance and requisition.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc gunsmith
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s training was augmented with gunsmithing and maintenance, serving [PAWN_possessive] merc unit's needs for weapon maintenance and requisition.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Battlesim developer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has an extensive expertise in programming and tactical combat, making [PAWN_possessive] a leading expert in BattleSim development - creating extremely effective training simulations for troops.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army engineer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a combat engineer with a major army detachment, servicing vehicles and equipment.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc engineer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a combat engineer with a famous merc unit, servicing their vehicles and equipment.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army medic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves as a combat medic, performing triage on the front lines, or more extensive medicine at a MASH (Mobile Army Surgical Hospital) unit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc medic
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is contracted as a mercenary combat medic, performing triage on the front lines, or more extensive medicine at a MASH (Mobile Army Surgical Hospital) unit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army scout
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves as a scout for a large detachment of troops, identifying hazards and potential ambush points.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc scout
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves as a scout for a veteran mercenary group, identifying hazards and potential ambush points.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army major
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as intelligence officer for a large army unit, providing tactical support and intel coordination for [PAWN_possessive] unit.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc major
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as intelligence officer for a large mercenary corps, providing tactical support and intel coordination.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army pilot

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc pilot
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was contracted as a military pilot to fly a variety of fighter and support craft, in multiple combat roles.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army commando
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served with a small army commando unit, executing strike or extraction missions deep behind enemy lines.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc commando
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served with a small merc commando unit, executing strike or extraction missions deep behind enemy lines.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Army demolitions
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a demolitions and heavy weapons expert in a large detachment of troops. [PAWN_pronoun] has an expertise in various explosives, as well as combat engineering.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Merc demolitions
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a demolitions and heavy weapons expert in a large merc unit. [PAWN_pronoun] has an expertise in various explosives, as well as combat engineering.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Mech pilot
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a Battlemech pilot, a Mech Warrior. Operating these massive walking tanks, MechWarriors serve in the armies of the Great Houses or as part of a Mercenary unit, fight in the gladiatorial arenas of Solaris VII, or operate on the fringes of society as pirates and bandits. Among the Clans, a MechWarrior can either be trueborn or freeborn, with the former enjoying greater social standing. The jumpship [PAWN_pronoun] was on suffered a jump-drive malfunction, casting them off into the unknown. After waiting several weeks for rescue, with supplies running low, the crew decided to use the escape pods at the nearest habitable planet...
